checks.alt: passed: accurately describes the student’s robot demonstration and the surrounding classmates’ and teacher’s newly impressed reactions without reproducing the idiom
checks.anatomy: passed: visible students and teacher have coherent heads, torsos, arms, hands, and poses; no obvious extra or missing human limbs
checks.meaning: passed: a student presents an inventive wheeled robot while classmates and the teacher react with wide-eyed surprise, smiles, and focused attention, clearly showing that they now view the student with fresh respect and admiration
checks.perspective_physics: passed: table, robot, solar panel, and figures use consistent depth and occlusion; the solar panel and lamp display are supported on the table and the robot is grounded on its surface
checks.robot_wheels_wiring_contact: passed: the robot has a readable chassis, four visible wheels with plausible axle/body attachment, articulated arm, camera head, and colored wiring; wheels and the robot base sit on the tabletop without obvious floating or severe interpenetration
checks.style: passed: unified warm colored-pencil and soft watercolor children’s illustration with paper grain and clear linework
checks.text_brand_watermark: passed: no readable text, brand marks, logos, or watermark visible; diagrams and screens contain only non-readable marks
